payload.text: **ST0007 design rulings** (hv, 2026-09-16 18:4xZ, to vc, reconciled with the shared-core preferences hv gave dc the same evening). (1) **Fail forward, no CI gate before the tag:** the core tags and pushes without waiting for CI, then reads CI for the release commit and reports a red verdict loudly; it undoes nothing. D40 is moot, and nothing is pushed to `main` ahead of the tag. (2) **Every `release:` key has a default and can be overridden**, `object:` included: no required key. (3) The core is a builtin named `release`, opt-in, and `build release` stays available as a project spelling. (4) **Conflab is in scope as an adopter**; no project is a special case except those frozen by ruling. (5) **devbin adopts first**, then the next project: Utilz was named first only because it looked simplest, so if another is simpler, take that one.
